answer: Between 3400 BCE and 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and axes/celts does not move in tandem with elements of symbolic capital: hatchets/swords and daggers remain static across the entire window (constant Z-values, zero variance, so co-movement with them is not definable), while house size — the only varying symbolic-capital component — declines sharply (HouseSize 2.05 → 0.19, Δ = −1.86 Z, slope −0.46 Z/100yr). In the same window both dependent variables follow a shared mid-window peak around 3200 BCE (MonumentCount −0.46 → 0.91 → −0.36; AxesCelts 0.37 → 2.60 → 0.80), i.e. an inverted-U intensification rather than a linear co-trend with symbolic capital. Level correlations over the five 100-year bins are weak/statistically indistinguishable from zero and, for house size, negative (MonumentCount–HouseSize r = −0.35, CI −0.94..0.77; AxesCelts–HouseSize r = −0.17, CI −0.91..0.84); correlations with hatchets/swords are r = +0.29 / −0.11; with daggers undefined. The monuments and axes series themselves co-vary strongly (r = 0.87, both peaking at ≈3200 BCE), and their net start-to-end movement is upward (Δ ≈ +0.10 and +0.43) — opposite in sign to the shrinking house-size component of symbolic capital. Controlling for pollen openness and growth changes nothing qualitatively (partial correlations stay near-zero/negative). Conclusion/hypothesis: in 3400–3000 BCE, monument and axe/celt counts show no positive relationship with contemporaneous symbolic capital; the relation to house size is negative, and the dominant process is a synchronous mid-window (≈3200 BCE) intensification of both monument construction and axe/celt deposition.

payload.workflow: 1) Загрузка time_series_data.csv, capital.csv (decimal=','), pollen-файла (decimal=','); 2) выделение 5 raw-бинов 3400–3000 BCE (CE кратные 100, calBP 4950–5350); 3) наклоны (OLS по индексу бина), изменение конец−начало, средние по половинам окна; 4) Pearson (Fisher 95% ДИ) и Spearman по n=5 для пар DV×предикторы и DV×DV; 5) част. корреляции DV–HouseSize с контролем openness (SMOOTH_MEAN_100y) и growth (pollen_grate_100); 6) сноска устойчивости на 401-точечных interpol-рядах; 7) формулировка natural-language гипотезы по согласованному паттерну (синхронный пик ~3200 BCE у обоих DV, статичные оружие/кинжалы, падающий HouseSize → нет положительной связи).
